name: PLTD
fix_description: In _tokenTransferSell, _bron is set to tAmount/2 without any cap, allowing attackers to set an arbitrary burn amount for the next transfer. Remove _bron mechanism entirely, or cap it to a small percentage of pair balance (e.g., 1%) to prevent draining the pair to near-zero.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step DeFi exploit involving nested flash loans, token swaps through a router, and abusing pair accounting via direct token transfer plus skim, which requires understanding AMM mechanics and fee-on-transfer token behavior. The code is still fairly short and not deeply protocol-internal, so it is more complex than a trivial bug but not hard-tier.
